title: Global Take-Home Pay & Statutory Tax Retention Index 2026
subtitle: Rigorous statutory comparison of net salary retention across 10 verified national revenue authority jurisdictions.
metaDescription: Benchmark statutory take-home pay percentages across US, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and New Zealand.
citationString: LivWorthy Research Institute. (2026). Global Take-Home Pay & Statutory Tax Retention Index 2026. https://www.livworthy.com/reports/global-take-home-pay-comparison
methodologyNotes: Standardizes compensation to normalized $100,000 USD purchasing equivalence across local currencies.
Models single filers under standard 2026 statutory rates including mandatory social security, health, and local resident taxes.
Verified exclusively against official statutory revenue publications without estimation.
summaryInsights: UAE, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia retain 97–100% of gross earnings due to zero personal income tax regimes (with modest local social insurance where applicable).
Singapore offers the highest net retention among major developed economies (92.4% on median executive compensation).
Germany and the United Kingdom exhibit the highest statutory deductions (effective rates exceeding 32–36%) when combining income tax and compulsory social security contributions.
